  time = 0
  n, m, rb, cb, rd, cd = testcase
  if rb == rd or cb == cd: return 0
  if rb < rd: r = rd-rb
  if rb > rd: r = 2*(n-rb)+rb-rd
  if cb < cd: c = cd - cb
  if cb > cd: c = 2*(m-cb)+cb-cd
  return min(r,c)

	h = H/2
	passo = h/2
	a = (h/H)*h/2
	while(abs(A-a)>= 0.00000001):
		if a > A:
			h -= passo
			a = (h/H)*h/2
		else:
			h += passo
			a = (h/H)*h/2	
		if passo <= 0.00000001:
			break	
		passo = passo/2
	return h

def order_corners(n, m, x, y):
    corners = [[1, 1], [n, m], [1, m], [n, 1]]
    distances = []
    for i, [a, b] in enumerate(corners):
        distances.append([a, b, abs(a - x) + abs(b - y)])
    distances.sort(key=lambda a: -a[2])
    return [[a[0], a[1]] for a in distances]
